retrieved_text.text: Colin Rand Kaepernick -LRB- -LSB- ` kæpərnɪk -RSB- ; born November 3 , 1987 -RRB- is an American football quarterback who is currently a free agent .
Kaepernick began his professional career as a backup to Alex Smith , but became the 49ers ' starter in the middle of the 2012 season after Smith suffered a concussion .
He remained the team 's starting quarterback for the rest of the season and went on to lead the 49ers to their first Super Bowl appearance since 1994 , losing to the Baltimore Ravens .
During the 2013 season , his first full season as a starter , Kaepernick helped the 49ers reach the NFC Championship , losing to the Seattle Seahawks .
In the following seasons , Kaepernick lost and won back his starting job , with the 49ers missing the playoffs for three years consecutively .
Katherine Matilda `` Tilda '' Swinton -LRB- born 5 November 1960 -RRB- is a British actress , performance artist , model , and fashion muse , known for her roles in independent and Hollywood films .
Swinton won the Volpi Cup for Best Actress at the Venice Film Festival for her performance as Isabella of France in Edward II -LRB- 1991 -RRB- .
Swinton was nominated for a Golden Globe Award for her performance in The Deep End -LRB- 2001 -RRB- .
Swinton later starred in the dark romantic fantasy drama , Only Lovers Left Alive -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .

retrieved_text.text: Fox Searchlight Pictures is an American film distribution company within the Fox Entertainment Group , a sister company of the larger Fox studio 20th Century Fox , all owned by Rupert Murdoch 's 21st Century Fox .
The Fox Film Corporation was an American company that produced motion pictures , formed by William Fox on 1 February 1915 .

As is the case with Fox 's television unit , all copyright notices of programming produced by a Fox-related company -LRB- with some exceptions -RRB- bear the copyright of the overall film studio , i.e. '' © -LRB- respective year -RRB- Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation '' .

The company 's first film studios were set up in Fort Lee , New Jersey but in 1917 , William Fox sent Sol M. Wurtzel to Hollywood , California to oversee the studio 's new West Coast production facilities where a more hospitable and cost effective climate existed for filmmaking .
Under new president Sidney Kent , the new owners merged the company with Twentieth Century Pictures to form 20th Century Fox in 1935 .
